d: Muzaffarpur PNG Blast : mujaphpharpur men ek jordar dhamake ne pure ilake ko dahla diya...nala nirman ke lie ho rahi khudaee ke dauran gais paiplain (Gas Pipeline Blast) men achanak visphot ho gaya... dhamaka itna jabardast tha ki aaspas ke kaee makan kshatigrast ho gae... sarak par khari gariyan bhi malbe men tabdil ho gaeen... hadse men ek vyakti ki maut ho gaee, jabki kaee log ghayal batae ja rahe hain... dhamake ke bad ilake men chikh-pukar mach gaee... pulis, prashasan aur phayar briged ki timen rahat aur bachav kary men jut gaee hain...!
